selfHelpStops.condition: The prosecutor or a victim files an objection.
The programme ended in a withheld adjudication rather than a dismissal.
The participant is choosing which record to spend one of the two capped expungements on.
Immigration, licensing or firearm consequences are in play.

requiredParticipantInputQuestions.question: Did the programme end in a dismissal of the charge?
Or did it end in a withheld adjudication rather than a dismissal?
Which programme did you complete — diversion, drug court, mental health court, veterans court, or another accountability court?
Have you already had two expungements granted for completing programmes like this? The cap is two.
In which county were the charges filed?

supportingDocuments.name: Certified local record showing the dismissal was entered
supportingDocuments.obtainedFrom: The clerk of the court where the charges were filed
supportingDocuments.howToObtain: Ask the clerk for a certified copy of the dismissal.

supportingDocuments.name: Certified ALEA criminal record
supportingDocuments.howToObtain: Request a certified criminal record from ALEA.

destination.name: Criminal division of the circuit court, county where the charges were filed
destination.detail: Court-controlled with a prosecutor and victim objection window.

manualCompletionItems: The petitioner signs their own petition.
